original_test_intent: Verify that a threshold event on the already failed device but outside its one-bank VLS region forces ADDDC to promote protection from bank VLS to rank VLS and clears rank CE bookkeeping.
original_method: Record source RAS settings and attested one-bank VLS predecessor; halt; prove dev0=0 is the same failed device and bank1 differs from protected bank0; set mask0x3 and inject exactly two CEs at bank1; confirm threshold; go once; optionally sample copy_in_progress=1; verify Region changes to rank VLS and per-rank CE counter clears; capture health and restore.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE supplies the predecessor region and same-device/bank mapping, controls two CEs/go and recovery while the agent compares ADDDC Region/counter state.
required_inputs: GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology and POR/non-POR disposition
Initial bank-VLS failed device/bank/rank and proof bank1 is outside it on same device
Threshold and bank-to-rank Region field/counter-clear oracle
SMM completion timeout, serial/OOB recovery and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Reject changed predecessor region, wrong device/bank relation or dirty baseline
Exactly two bank1 CEs; do not repeat to catch a transient copy bit
Stop on absent/unexpected promotion, counter mismatch, hang or health degradation
Preserve topology transition and recover/restore under owner control
agent_execution_scope: Capture two CEs, threshold and post-SMM region/counter evidence
Observe copy state without making it sole acceptance
Do not choose target, inject/retry/recover independently or issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: From an attested bank-VLS state, threshold the same failed device in an unprotected bank and verify durable rank-level promotion after SMM.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row174 Wistron-System RAS-00131-V003: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM POR/non-POR population, CScripts version/hash/license and SMI/threshold2/ADDDC mappings; provide the predecessor one-bank VLS device/bank/rank, prove dev0=0 bank1 is the same device in a different unprotected bank, define threshold and bank-to-rank Region/counter-clear oracle, SMM timeout and OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the geometry that selects rank promotion explicit, relies on durable Region evidence rather than fleeting copy status and protects downstream VLS state from retries.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once one bank on a device is spared, a new threshold on another bank of the same device means the fault scope spans banks while device identity stays constant. ADDDC must therefore expand protection to the rank rather than allocate a second unrelated bank region. The post-SMM Region value proves that policy choice; counter clearing proves SMM consumed the threshold. Copy status only indicates transient work and may be missed, so it supports rather than defines acceptance.
